description: This file contains the implementation of the ConnectionManager class, responsible for managing network connections to other endpoints within Orleans runtime. It handles creating, maintaining, and terminating connections, including connection retries, parallel connection attempts, and connection lifecycle events.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Sealed internal class managing network connections, including establishing, tracking, and closing connections to silo addresses within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: ConnectionEntry
classes.description: Nested class representing connection state for a specific silo address, including active connections, pending connection attempts, and retry logic.

methods.name: ConnectionManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ConnectionManager with necessary options, factory, and tracing components.

methods.name: ConnectionCount
methods.description: Property returning total number of active connections.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Task that completes when the ConnectionManager is shut down.

methods.name: GetConnectedAddresses
methods.description: Returns a list of all currently connected silo addresses.

methods.name: GetConnection
methods.description: Returns an existing suitable connection or initiates a new connection attempt asynchronously.

methods.name: TryGetConnection
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a current connection for a given endpoint without initiating a new connection.

methods.name: GetConnectionAsync
methods.description: Performs the actual asynchronous process to establish a new connection to the endpoint.

methods.name: OnConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles logic when a connection attempt fails, updating retry delay info.

methods.name: OnConnected
methods.description: Updates internal state when a connection is successfully established.

methods.name: OnConnectionTerminated
methods.description: Handles cleanup and logging when a connection is terminated.

methods.name: GetOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Fetches or creates a connection entry state object for a specific silo address.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Implements the connection attempt, including timeout and exception handling, and updates connection state on success or failure.

methods.name: CloseAsync
methods.description: Closes all active connections for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Initiates shutdown of all connections managed by the ConnectionManager.

methods.name: StartConnection
methods.description: Starts a background task to run the connection lifecycle.

methods.name: RunConnectionAsync
methods.description: Handles active connection operation, including running the connection and cleanup on termination.

methods.name: BeginConnectionScope
methods.description: Creates a logging scope for a connection if logging is enabled at the critical level.
